subject: integration
name: Orivon Featured apps
summary: A fixed list of five apps (Explore, WebTorrent, ASGARDEX, Ledger Wallet, The Lounge) with one-line summaries and icons, held in the release: the catalogue row in the browser, the tiles in the new tab's page, which has no network. It fetches nothing and matches no need. A tile only opens ipfs://<app>.orivonstack.eth like a typed address: that site is judged on its own, and nothing here checks what the name currently opens. Level 4 because all it runs and shows is pinned and it makes no connection; opening a tile is the person's own visit. Judged here by its publisher.
